Subject: Multiparametric MRI Prostate | Facility: Tergooi MC | Date: 08 February 2025

Clinical Indication: Evaluation of rising PSA (31.0 ng/mL) and prior positive biopsy.

FINDINGS:
Prostatic parenchyma occupies 32.52 mL of space. T2-weighted sequences highlight a focal hypointense focus within the right mid-gland posterior peripheral zone, spanning 18 x 14 x 12 mm. Diffusion-weighted imaging exhibits pronounced restriction, mirrored by low ADC signal. Dynamic contrast enhancement demonstrates early, focal uptake localized to the lesion. Seminal vesicles appear intact, with no evidence of extracapsular spread or suspicious pelvic lymphadenopathy.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 5 lesion in the right mid-gland posterior peripheral zone.
Prostate volume 32.52 mL; PSA density 0.95 ng/mL/mL.
csPCa predicted probability 0.9289904.
